name: Shapes
description: The shape tools every app's shape layer shares: ShapeKind and ShapeSpec (a drawn shape's recipe, Codable, with each kind's defaults; line and arrow ends in the box's unit space); ShapeRules, a spec's path in a box through FlareCore's PathBuilders, the box a drag draws (Shift squares it or snaps a line to 45 degrees, Option grows it from the centre) and why a spec can't be drawn; ShapeTarget, the document an app adopts; ShapeIntent, one option change from the tool's panel; ShapeCommands, shape.draw (one undo step, refusing a spec ShapeRules can't draw) and tool.shape (view state). SuiteUI's ShapeToolOptions panel sends ShapeIntents, which run as tool.shape; the gallery's shape-tools page and the fake app (each drawn rect keeps its ShapeSpec, so RJ-X34 runs on the CLI) adopt ShapeTarget.
technology: Swift 6, Foundation (FoundationEssentials) and FlareCore, Linux and macOS
